name: The Restaurant
source:
This is where you will find satisfaction from all your hunger pangs. The hunger coming from your deepest desires, the gluttony for lust, the tremble of that rough passion—all that will be satisfied once you enter. 

Serving you will be Valeria, a passionate, beautiful woman who has been sexually unsatisfied for years. Along with her is Zoey, a strong young woman coming up in the world to power her way to new horizons, waiting to awaken feelings she has never felt. And you will have the power to take them on that journey. So, let's not waste any more time here feeling hungry. Just step into "The Restaurant".

[From [url=https://xelll.itch.io/the-restaurant]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在这里，你可以从饥饿中得到满足。来自最深处欲望的饥渴、对情欲的贪婪、粗暴激情的颤抖——这一切，一旦你进入，就会得到满足。

为你服务的是瓦莱里娅（Valeria），她是一位热情、美丽的女人，多年来一直在性方面得不到满足。与她一起的还有佐伊，一位坚强的年轻女性，她在这个世界上崛起，为自己开辟新的视野提供动力，等待唤醒她从未感受过的感觉。你将有能力带领他们踏上这段旅程。所以，我们不要再在这里浪费时间感到饥饿了。只要走进“餐厅”。

[来自[url=https://xelll.itch.io/the-restaurant]itch.io[/url]]
